Na-jung has an unfinished 'dream'.

It is to paint as much as you want without worrying about money.

After joining a large company with a high salary, I was taking a class at an art academy, and the time to draw the upper body nude came unexpectedly. Na-jung was not unfamiliar with the identity of the model that appeared in front of her.

It was the day.

therefore,

why… … … … Is the manager out there?

He was a boss famous for being cool-headed, Han Jeong-woo, team leader. To make matters worse, Na-jung is caught attending class... … … … !

After learning about the boss's taste, the company life seemed to be rough.

“I heard you can’t sleep because of my body.”

"You keep thinking about it."

However, this man keeps appearing in front of my eyes.

What is this man's real face?
